title: Waiting Addition for Pending Cancellation Requests on Northgate Protect Standard Plans
content:
A waiting addition raises the Northgate Protect Standard plan cancellation refund where the plan holder's most recent cancellation request on the plan that is still submitted, neither confirmed nor withdrawn, has waited some days: the long-wait rate of 8 percent (0.08) at 45 days or more, the short-wait rate of 4 percent (0.04) at 14 days or more but fewer than 45 days, and nothing for fewer days or no such request.

The days waited are calendar days from the date the request was recorded to today, and the rate raises the refund by that percentage of it.

| Most recent still-submitted cancellation request has waited | Refund raised by |
|---|---|
| 45 days or more | 8 percent |
| 14 to 44 days | 4 percent |
| 0 to 13 days | Nothing |
| No such request | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical)

- 45 days: 8 percent; 44 days: 4 percent.
- 14 days: 4 percent; 13 days: nothing.
- A request that was withdrawn, or one already confirmed, is not a still-submitted request.
